vocabulary.definition: having many different forms, elements, or features
vocabulary.example: The immune system is so manifold that it's impossible to cover in one video.

vocabulary.definition: an event causing great and often sudden damage or suffering
vocabulary.example: Inside the wound, a horrible catastrophe has happened with dead cells and bacteria invade.
The cells release an onslaught of chemical alarm signals to awaken the immune system.

vocabulary.definition: enduring pain and hardship without showing one's feelings or complaining
vocabulary.example: The macrophage, though stoic in principle, attacks bacteria without mercy.
Neutrophils, in their attacks, cause collateral damage to the body's own cells.
The helper T cells invigorate the tired macrophages, urging them to continue fighting.
